desc: 📈 Dynamic canvas leveling with per-server themes, rank cards, welcome banners, and milestone auto-roles.
opt_role: Role to assign (leave empty to clear)
no_xp: {error} No XP data found. Chat to earn XP!
manage_only: ⛔ You need **Manage Server** permission to set level roles.
role_set: {check} Members who reach **Level {level}** will automatically receive {role}.
title: Leveling
heading: Leveling on {guild}
summaryNone: Nobody has XP yet: members earn it by chatting.
channelHere: In the channel where the member is chatting
roleAbove: Above my role: drag ARCHON above it in Server Settings → Roles
roleManaged: Managed by an integration or too powerful, so I can't give it
bannersHint: Change them with the Banner colours button, or with /leveling theme.
themeNeedColor: Give at least one colour, for example `#5865f2`.
themeUsage: Usage: `.leveling theme level <start> <end> <accent>` or `.leveling theme welcome <accent>`. Colour names work, like `gold` or `#FFD700`.
setroleAbove: I can't give {role}: it's above my role. Drag ARCHON above it in Server Settings → Roles, then try again.
setroleManaged: I can't give {role}: it's managed by an integration, or it's @everyone.
setrolePowerful: {role} has admin-level permissions, so I won't hand it out automatically. Pick a plain role.
setroleFailed: I couldn't save that level role. Try again in a moment; if it keeps failing, tell the bot owner.
createDone: Created {n} level role(s) and set them as rewards. They have no permissions: they're only a badge.
createNothing: Every level already has a role.
createNoPerm: I need the Manage Roles permission to create roles.
createReused: Reused {n} role(s) you already had with the same name.
streakHint: Earned with /claim on consecutive days. Change them in the dashboard (Economy).
themeIntro: Pick a ready theme or a colour for each part. Every change is saved and shown right away.
themeOtherHint: Type a name or a hex code
themeLevelNote: Used on level-up banners and /leveling rank cards.
themeWelcomeNote: The welcome card keeps its dark background so names stay readable; this colour is its frame, bars and highlights.
themeLowContrast: The accent is hard to read on this background. Tap **Fix the accent** and ARCHON picks a close colour that stands out.
themeBadColour: I don't know that colour. Type a name like `gold` or `royal blue`, or a hex code like `#FF5733`.
themeNoIcon: This server has no icon, or ARCHON couldn't read it. Pick a ready theme instead.
themeDefaultWelcome: default (the member's role colour, otherwise green)
